data.name: Maharaja
data.gender_notes: Maharaja is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who rules over a kingdom or a region. The name Maharaja carries the meaning “Great King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Maharaja usually hope their child will grow to embody great king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner ruler, the soul, and the supreme ruler, God.
data.etymology: Maharaja belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Great King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maharaja total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The title "Maharaja" holds immense historical significance in Indian culture as it symbolizes the monarchy and its power. It has been used extensively in various regal depictions in art, literature, and the media.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, "Maharaja" also represents the ruler or the master of one's own self and soul. It signifies the inner king or the divine Self that resides within each individual and calls for the development of inner wisdom and nobility.
